cohort: 143,190 neonates screened for CH in 38 health centers of 10 cities in Yazd province, Iran, from March 2008 to February 2015.
finding: The 7-year incidence of congenital hypothyroidism (CH) in Yazd province, Iran was 303 per 100,000 live births, which is higher than other provinces in Iran, with first cousin consanguinity, hospitalization, male sex, low birth weight, and cesarean section delivery identified as significant predictors.
